project.title: TrailCam B2 Balance FPV Rover

process.printer: Anycubic Kobra 3 Max candidate; exact machine profile unresolved

coordinate_frame.origin: intersection of the common wheel axis and vehicle longitudinal center plane
coordinate_frame.y_axis: +Y vehicle left along the wheel axis
coordinate_frame.z_axis: +Z up in the nominal balanced pose
coordinate_frame.transform_convention: row-major 4x4 matrix maps component source coordinates to project millimetres

requirements.statement: The product shall have exactly two independently driven wheels on one common geometric axis and no caster, suspension, steering linkage or second axle.
requirements.verification: component count, datum and assembly-envelope checks

requirements.statement: The body shall use IMU and wheel-encoder feedback in a bounded active balance controller; direct RC-to-motor PWM is prohibited.
requirements.verification: control architecture review, deterministic simulation, HIL and restrained physical tests

requirements.statement: The assembled design shall remain within 260 mm width, 190 mm length and 250 mm upright height with 110 to 130 mm wheels.
requirements.verification: exact CAD bounds and purchased-part envelope audit

requirements.statement: The target mass is 1800 g, maximum design mass 2200 g, with center of mass 70 to 110 mm above the axle, lateral offset at most 3 mm and longitudinal trim of plus or minus 12 mm.
requirements.verification: CAD mass-property estimate followed by component weighing and assembled balance measurement

requirements.statement: Non-rolling replaceable landing protection shall remain clear in normal balance motion and contact no earlier than 22 degrees body tilt.
requirements.verification: exact pitch sweep and restrained tip test

requirements.statement: Each wheel channel shall target 100 to 150 rpm, at least 0.35 Nm continuous output torque and a current-limited transient target of 1.0 Nm.
requirements.verification: supplier-curve review and restrained drivetrain dynamometer test

requirements.statement: The protected fixed-tilt analog FPV camera and ELRS control receiver shall use independent video and control paths.
requirements.verification: wiring review, camera field-of-view check and independent link-loss tests

requirements.statement: Critical geometry shall be parametric B-Rep; purchased components own their exact mating geometry; concept pixels are not dimensional authority.
requirements.verification: source audit, interface-owner audit and CAD regression tests

requirements.statement: Arming, watchdog, stale-data detection, bounded commands, overcurrent and undervoltage handling, tip disarm and deliberate re-arm shall be verified before free balancing.
requirements.verification: fault-injection matrix, HIL and restrained physical test ladder

global_style.summary: Open ribbed anthracite FDM structure with orange replaceable camera and landing protection, visible service fasteners and compact centered massing.
global_style.generation_material: No image-to-3D generation; the approved image is appearance evidence only.
global_style.detail_hierarchy: axle and protected envelopes first, load path and service access second, TrailCam styling last

assembly_sequence: Join the printed chassis set with measured metal through-fasteners and verify the axle datum.
Install the purchased motor brackets and encoder gearmotors without wheels.
Install the battery cradle, control tray and the measured electronics stack with the IMU on its rigid datum.
Route fused battery power, motor leads, encoder leads and signal harnesses through their separated cable corridors.
Install camera guard, camera, VTX, receiver and antenna mounts while preserving optical, RF and cooling keep-outs.
Install the non-rolling landing set and verify the exact pitch-contact sweep before powered tests.
Install measured metal hubs and wheels; verify coaxiality, retention, rotation and pinch clearances.
Measure total mass and center of mass, trim the battery position and repeat the pitch/contact sweep.
Perform unpowered, wheels-off-ground, restrained, tethered and only then free-balance validation stages.

decision_log.topic: Approve this functional decomposition, interface ownership and validation routing before production CAD.
decision_log.current_basis: Requirements and concept revision 0.1.0-r1 are approved; this plan is the first controlled decomposition candidate.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Explicit human approval of the decomposition candidate.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the Anycubic printer, PETG product, drying state, orientation and complete machine/process/filament JSON profile set.
decision_log.current_basis: A 0.6 mm nozzle and 0.24 mm layers are planning assumptions only.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Named installed profiles and process-matched fit coupons.

decision_log.topic: Qualify the two motor and encoder assemblies.
decision_log.current_basis: Pololu item 4755, 100:1 37D 12 V encoder gearmotor, matches the 100 rpm speed class and offers a measured supplier envelope.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Two purchased samples, shaft runout and encoder polarity checks, torque/current/thermal characterization and exact mass.

decision_log.topic: Select the exact 120 mm class wheels and metal 6 mm D-shaft to wheel-hub system.
decision_log.current_basis: Only a 120 x 40 mm planning envelope and 205 mm wheel-center track are frozen.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Supplier drawing plus two measured wheel and hub samples, retention method, mass and inertia.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the exact controller, IMU carrier, motor driver, current sensing, regulated supplies, fuse and disconnect.
decision_log.current_basis: Teensy 4.1, ICM-42688-P-class SPI IMU and Cytron MDD10A are candidates; MDD10A has no intrinsic current telemetry and therefore needs qualified external sensing or replacement.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Purchased and measured boards, current-sensor choice, timing and noise tests, thermal/fault behavior and complete power schematic.

decision_log.topic: Freeze battery voltage, capacity, connector, BEC, fusing, regeneration and emergency-disconnect behavior.
decision_log.current_basis: A centered 3S LiPo-class pack is a packaging assumption; opening the circuit during regenerative braking is an unresolved hazard.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Power budget, measured pack, safe disconnect architecture, transient test and runtime evidence.

decision_log.topic: Close the mass and center-of-mass budget.
decision_log.current_basis: Target geometry provides a sliding battery trim but supplier and printed masses are incomplete.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Mass ledger, CAD properties using qualified densities, physical weighing and hang/balance measurement.

decision_log.topic: Approve the restrained tuning rig, exclusion zone, fault matrix and staged energy limits.
decision_log.current_basis: The design specification defines the test ladder but no rig or physical procedure is approved.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Human-reviewed test plan, rig inspection and witnessed staged results.
